items.t: SMTP 451 4.7.1 - the fifty-emails lesson

items.x: Low priority TL;DR: A bulk send to 100 recipients hit WPX's mail throttle: 50 emails per 30 minutes per mailbox. Not a bug a deliberate guard on a mail service built for correspondence, not campaigns. The lesson the fellowship's mailers keep re learning since 2023: bulk belongs on a dedicated sender. Source: WPX ticket 996300, "SMTP Error: [451] 4.7.1" (WPX support portal). Read the full story → Kevin F. tried to send a bulk email to around 100 people and got SMTP error 451 4.7.1 , resorting to copy paste batches. Ilona B. at WPX explained the design: 50 emails per 30 minutes per mailbox , an automatic protection for the mail servers' IP reputation rather than a fault. Exceed it and the mailbox cools off

Alfred and Littlebird structurally cannot cause this kind of slowdown they connect through a private, authenticated tool, never as public bot traffic.
